verbatim_quote.original: خب ببین یک task ایجاد کن و postfix apply concurrency هایی که نیازه رو انجام بده... کل تیم هم بررسی کنن حالت autopilot اتوماتیک، کامل کامل انجامش بده، می‌خوام release بعدی رو بزنیم بیرون.
verbatim_quote.english_translation: Create a task and apply the needed postfix fixes including concurrency... full team reviews, automatic autopilot, complete it fully, I want to ship the next release.

extracted_decision.summary: Create one final consolidation task; apply all needed postfix fixes including concurrency; cover every task file in the patch; full-team review; autopilot; complete fully; ship the next release.
extracted_decision.rationale: 832-864 patch needs a single release-gate cleanup before the next release.
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: One broad diff vs many small ones.
